ask: Post this behind-the-scenes clip of how our candles get their swirl to TikTok, followers only, no duets: https://cdn.example.com/bts.mp4

arguments.content: Ever wondered how a candle gets its swirl?

steps.why: TikTok needs one video from a public link the user gave.

The decision: followers only and duets off, because the user asked for both. Privacy defaults to public, so it must be set; the details call refuses a misspelled level. Only the switches they named: stitches and comments stay as they are.

say: Saved to Acme as a TikTok draft: followers only, duets off. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: Assuming public when the user didn't say: ask.
Saying a paid or brand video is disclosed without setting it: brand_organic_toggle or brand_content_toggle in platform_specific (see tiktok-brand-disclosure).
